## A0: healing of injected error with a fixed per-step energy (FP model, seeds 0–31)
Error added at every step to the guided prediction (4 eps channels), white in space, energy per sample = heig-8's measured ‖δ_g,t‖² profile. Final-latent error ‖x0 − x0_FP‖², mean over seeds.

| time pattern | final-latent error |
| --- | ---: |
| (i) same vector every step | 34.19 |
| (ii) same vector, alternating sign | 0.05004 |
| (iii) independent vector every step | 2.487 |

(ii)/(iii) = 0.020 [0.008, 0.048]; (ii)/(i) = 0.0015 [0.0009, 0.0025]. Unperturbed reference bit-exact vs the FP eval latents: True.

**Read (period-2 error healed like random error): FAIL as written** — (ii) is not within 20% of (iii) because it is ~50× *smaller*: a sign-alternating error cancels to first order across adjacent steps, beyond what independent error averages to. A period-2 error is the most-healed pattern of the three.

## A1: the pair (mean over 112 layers; H-norm of E = (W − W_q)(I − VVᵀ) under the saved PHP)
Fixed-grid solver reproduces W_q¹ exactly (max mismatch fraction 0).

| table | weights ≠ W_q¹ | ‖E‖²/‖E₁‖² | ρ_pair = ‖E₁ + E‖²/‖E₁‖² |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| W_q² (mirror, clamped T) | 0.555 | 3.63 | 3.46 |
| W_q³ (reverse order) | 0.293 | 1.00 | 2.32 |
| W_q⁴, W_q⁵ (random orders; exploratory) | — | 1.00, 1.02 | 2.44 (1,4) |
| W_q²ᵤ (unclamped mirror; exploratory) | 0.545 | 1.84 | 1.63 |

Independent equal-size errors give ρ_pair = 2; a perfect mirror pair is bounded below by one half-step (5-bit) rounding error, ρ_pair ≳ 1.
